## File: facebookresearch_attentivenas/sampler/attentive_nas_sampler.py

Prompts

```
['build an ArchSampler instance from an architecture-to-FLOPs map file with a discretization step and model', 'sample a single target FLOPs value from the probability distribution or uniformly at random', 'sample neural network architecture configurations that match a target FLOPs budget using probability-based selection', 'build a transition probability matrix from an architecture-to-FLOPs map file by counting and normalizing observations', 'review the round_flops function that discretizes FLOPs values to the nearest multiple of a given step']
```

Usage

```
{'build_arch_sampler': 'build an ArchSampler instance from an architecture-to-FLOPs map file with a discretization step and model', 'sample_target_flops': 'sample a single target FLOPs value from the probability distribution or uniformly at random', 'sample_archs_according_to_flops': 'sample neural network architecture configurations that match a target FLOPs budget using probability-based selection', 'build_transition_prob_matrix': 'build a transition probability matrix from an architecture-to-FLOPs map file by counting and normalizing observations', 'review_round_flops': 'review the round_flops function that discretizes FLOPs values to the nearest multiple of a given step'}
```
